parse_tar_in_memory: parse an in-memory TAR file from bytes and yield file names with memoryview contents
parse_tar_file_object: parse a TAR file from a file-like object and yield file names with bytes contents
iterate_tar_entries: iterate over all entries in a TAR archive yielding tuples of file path and data
review_iter_tarfile: review the iter_tarfile function that parses TAR files and yields file path and contents
summarize_SupportsRead: summarize the SupportsRead protocol that defines a file-like object with a read method
